465-585-3742-4251-4742.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

4247-5276-5332-6524.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

301-6258-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

315-4465-7806--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

907-1479-3604.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Cadric (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

475-3263-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3263-4186-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
2557-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
2557-5702--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Parallel Lives.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Parallel Lives
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Parallel Lives.
Repeat from step 5.

3923-4050-4668-7639.description:

Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.

2558-2829-3000-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5173-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3073-3398-7121.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
3073-3398-7121.description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and its firebending ability twice.
Resolve both Hellkite Charger firebending triggers, adding eight {R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

372-4681-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6753-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1238-2351-2511-5467-7040.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

3518-4195-4574-6900.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

654-5414-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-5414-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

5200-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.
5200-6479.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

4050-4125-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4050-4125-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Shipwreck Dowser and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Shipwreck Dowser, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6283-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-5231-6283-6458.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1887-2583-5870-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
1887-2583-5870-5902.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

411-2595-4103-4613.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
411-2595-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-2595-4103-4613.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage by paying {2} and tapping it.
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3542-6056.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1170-3542-6056.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Agoraphobia by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Agoraphobia spell.
Activate Agoraphobia by paying {2}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2178-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2034-2178-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Devil, adding {C}{C}.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

144-1636-4050-4319.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield face down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Ashcloud Phoenix face up.
Repeat.

2464-4824-4944.notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has one or two lore counters on it.
2464-4824-4944.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Soliton ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-3020-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Puppeteer Clique does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent has at least one creature card in their graveyard.
2034-3020-4170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique, adding {C}{C}.
Puppeteer Clique dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Puppeteer Clique enters the battlefield, putting any creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from Puppeteer Clique, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature your opponent owns, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3742-4125-4872.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
3742-4125-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser that is tapped and attacking.
Shipwreck Dowser enters, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
